paper_metadata.title: Brief Papers_______________________________________________________________________________
paper_metadata.abstract: A dual band low-noise amplifier (LNA) with matched inputs and outputs, implemented in Infineon Technologies’ B7HF SiGe process, is presented. Both the single-ended inputs and outputs are matched to 50 without external elements. For the low-band (800 MHz–1 GHz), the LNA has a measured gain of 17 dB and a noise figure below 1.2 dB at 900 MHz. The high-band (1.8–2 GHz) LNA achieves a gain of 15 dB and a noise figure below 1.5 dB at 1.9 GHz. Both LNAs consume 5 mA dc current with a power supply voltage range from 2.7–3.6 V.
